notes.title: 1.0d Minor Game Update
notes.content:
We've been watching you guys play!
So, before we continue with a small update list...
Thank you for playing :)
It means a lot to this small developer duo!
 
We made a few QoL changes to the game:
- Added a small light to indicate where first key appears after the player triggers the event for the first cabin puzzle.
- Made it obvious where the meds are after being chased through the cave maze, so your character can see better if injured, for one of the puzzles closer to the end of the game.
- Hidden locations in the explorable forest now more interactive when found.
- Added one additional 'Autosave' point.

Keep getting lost in the woods, Everyone !!!
-The Geek Fried Maters
